nodes.name: Every 10 minutes
nodes.notes: Mail is lower-churn than ADO PRs, so 10 min rather than 5. The widget manifest sets source: n8n, so this is the only cadence that matters - refresh_minutes there is null.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Config comes from the container env (N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false in docker-compose.yml). No secret is read here - the OAuth2 token lives in n8n's credential store and never in workflow JSON.

nodes.name: Fetch inbox messages
nodes.notes: Needs an Entra app registration with delegated Mail.Read + offline_access, connected in n8n as a Microsoft Outlook OAuth2 credential. See deploy/n8n/README.md. The credential id here is a placeholder - repoint this node at the real credential after creating it. Never paste a token into this node.

nodes.name: Shape error payload
nodes.notes: Jytte stores this verbatim in widget_state.last_error and renders it in the freshness banner, so keep it to code + message. Never add the credential or token to this payload.

meta.notes: Mail fetch for the `email` widget. Microsoft Graph via the microsoftOutlook node (folderMessage:getAll against /mailFolders/inbox/messages), scoped to the last EMAIL_LOOKBACK_HOURS and capped at EMAIL_FETCH_LIMIT. Senders are tagged against EMAIL_DOMAINS_TRUSTWORKS / EMAIL_DOMAINS_DAGROFA / EMAIL_COMPUTERWORLD_SENDER. The payload shape is documented at the top of app/widgets/email/card.html. BEFORE ACTIVATING: create the Entra app registration (delegated Mail.Read + offline_access), connect it in n8n as a Microsoft Outlook OAuth2 credential, and repoint the 'Fetch inbox messages' node at it. The IMAP route was rejected: n8n's IMAP node is trigger-only so it cannot sit behind a Schedule Trigger, and M365 is retiring IMAP basic auth. The EMAIL_IMAP_* vars in .env are unused by this workflow.
